title: spinulum annotinum subsp. alpestre
intro: Spinulum annotinum subsp. alpestre, commonly known as Alpine Hair Cap, is a plant species that belongs to the family Polypodiaceae. It is a type of fern with a rich history of use in traditional medicine, valued for its potential health benefits. The plant is believed to exhibit therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may contribute to its use in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Alpine Hair Cap include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are thought to be responsible for its medicinal properties.
